positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Our vision is to create games that have unique systems, mechanics, and story. Many things are overused in games, so we will make it our priority to create games that are unique and fun at the same time.

projects.title: Resolute Dark Starless Spaces
projects.description: Resolute Dark Starless Spaces is a single player 3D horror game by Redev Games, putting the player in a large space station out in the middle of nowhere. Something happens within the station, forcing the whole crew to go into a deep sleep in order to wait for help. But with the distress signal never being sent, help never arrives. The ships computer, Posi, wakes one person at a time in order to fix it; while it's other personality, Negi, is trying to kill them all off. Can you survive?

projects.title: Snowpocalypse
projects.description:
Redev Games decided to do a short game for the holidays.

Santa has a big surprise planned this year. He is giving out zombie snowmen to all the good girls and boys. Unfortunately, the zombies have taken over the workshop and he needs your help to save Christmas!

Directed by Jonathan Karns
Programmed by Jonathan Karns
2D Art by Thomas Kuharski
3D Models by Jonathan Karns and Anthony Carbajal
Music Directed by Anthony Carbajal
